name: TopDawg Wholesale Dropshipping
author: TopDawg Wholesale Dropshipping

sections.description:
The TopDawg Wholesale Dropshipping plugin is designed exclusively for TopDawg resellers who have integrated their WooCommerce store with the TopDawg platform.

This plugin helps online sellers source and sell high-quality products from trusted U.S.-based suppliers. With access to over 500,000 wholesale products—including home goods, pet supplies, apparel, and more—you can quickly find profitable items to list without managing inventory or shipping.

TopDawg simplifies dropshipping by providing:

  • Real-time product data and inventory updates
  • Competitive pricing and automated syncing of images, descriptions, and stock levels
  • Seamless order fulfillment directly from U.S. warehouses to your customers
  • Smart automation features like shipping rate calculations and tracking updates

By removing the complexity of sourcing and fulfillment, TopDawg allows sellers to focus on growing their business, increasing profits, and delivering value to customers.

Visit TopDawg WooCommerce Integration to get started.

TopDawg Features & Benefits

  • Access 500,000+ Products – Instantly browse high-quality items from verified U.S. suppliers, no inventory required.
  • One-Click Product Import & Sync – Quickly import products with auto-sync for pricing, images, and descriptions.
  • Dropshipping from U.S. Suppliers – Fast, reliable shipping directly from verified U.S. warehouses.
  • Real-Time Inventory Updates – Prevent overselling with accurate stock levels synced automatically.
  • Fully Automated Order Fulfillment – Orders are processed and sent to customers without manual intervention.
  • No Need for Warehousing – Sell online without storing inventory, ideal for lean operations and scaling.
  • Smart Time-Saving Automation – Automate key tasks like order routing, shipping updates, and tracking numbers.
  • Premium Customer Support – Get expert help from our responsive support team whenever needed.

About the Plugin

This plugin helps manage your WooCommerce store’s TopDawg products efficiently by:

  • Media Sync & Cleanup – Ensures no orphaned, duplicate, or extra product images exist in your media library.
  • Live Shipping Rates – Provides accurate shipping costs for TopDawg products in real-time at checkout.
  • Real-Time Order Updates – Displays live fulfillment status for TopDawg orders and order items.
  • Tracking Details for Customers – Automatically updates customers with shipping and tracking information.

These features ensure your store remains organized, your customers are informed, and your order fulfillment is seamless.

How to Integrate with TopDawg

The plugin works automatically for stores that are already integrated with TopDawg.

If you are not yet a TopDawg user or haven’t integrated your WooCommerce store, you have two options to get started:

  1. Install and Connect via Plugin – Once the plugin is activated, it will prompt you to connect with TopDawg. Follow the on-screen instructions to create an account (if you don’t have one) and integrate your store.
  2. Connect via TopDawg Website – Visit TopDawg WooCommerce Integration, create an account, and link your WooCommerce store through the reseller dashboard.

Once connected, your store will automatically start syncing TopDawg products, inventory, pricing, and orders.

Security and Privacy

This plugin communicates securely with the TopDawg Wholesale Platform to enable product, order, and inventory synchronization between your WooCommerce store and TopDawg’s systems.

External Service Used

TopDawg Wholesale Platform — provides product catalog data, order fulfillment, and shipping information.

Data Shared

When integrated, the plugin transmits only the necessary store identifiers, product updates, and order fulfillment details between your WooCommerce store and TopDawg’s API.
No customer payment information or sensitive personal data is sent.

Authentication

All inbound requests from TopDawg servers are verified using a built-in shared secret known only to TopDawg’s backend services and the plugin itself.

This shared secret:

  • Is not user-specific or configurable.
  • Exists solely to verify request signatures using HMAC-SHA256.
  • Does not expose customer or reseller credentials.

Privacy Compliance

For more details, please review:

  • TopDawg Privacy Policy
  • TopDawg Terms of Use

Support & Contact

For technical assistance, integration guidance, or troubleshooting related to the TopDawg Wholesale Dropshipping plugin:

  • Visit the official TopDawg Support Page
  • Or contact our team directly through your TopDawg reseller dashboard.

We’re here to help you connect your WooCommerce store to TopDawg quickly and securely.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for TopDawg Wholesale Dropshipping.
  3. Click Install and then Activate.
  4. Follow the on-screen instructions to connect your WooCommerce store with TopDawg.

Manual Installation (optional)

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload the extracted topdawg-wholesale-dropshipping folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Go to Plugins in your WordPress dashboard and click Activate.
  4. Follow the on-screen instructions to connect your store with TopDawg.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with all WooCommerce stores?

No. This plugin is exclusively for WooCommerce stores integrated with the TopDawg platform.

How do I integrate my WooCommerce store with TopDawg?

You can integrate via the plugin prompt after installation or visit TopDawg WooCommerce Integration to connect manually.

Will this plugin affect my existing products?

No. The plugin only interacts with TopDawg products and ensures that non-TopDawg products remain unaffected.

Can I use this plugin without a TopDawg account?

No. A TopDawg account and WooCommerce integration are required.
